Core semantics, must be closed before the first RC. FIXED in code 30/09 (call-site stack-arg placement + callee stack-arg load; `NativeCrossWideArgsE2ETest` 3/3 JVM≡riscv64≡aarch64); issue open pending close.

Design front `D-SIZE-BUDGET` (Phase 1 = measurement only): a size/observability contract for the KOF distribution; no behaviour or dependency changes, no CI blocking. Not part of the 1.0 core surface; accepted after 1.0 (rule-6 decision request tracked separately).

CLI ergonomics — `kof build`/`kof test` with SEPARATE Kof source roots (`src/main/kof` + `src/test/kof`); NOT a 1.0 blocker (tooling surface). The interface decision (rule 6) is DECIDED (`D-CLI-SOURCE-ROOTS`) and IMPLEMENTED 30/09: `kof.toml [sources] app/test`, recursive discovery for a declared root, the app root threaded as source path so `import` resolves without copies; `kof build`/`kof test` with no positional use the declared roots and fail explicitly (R6) otherwise. The three interface-independent defects were fixed earlier in the same issue (a `compileForTestsSources(..., moduleRoot)` stale-field forward; b silent no-op on an empty root → exit 1; c tests root discarded → PKG004). Proof `TwoRootsCliE2ETest` 3/3 (jvm+native+js, no copies) + `KofProjectConfigTest`.

Test tooling only, outside the 1.0 core surface; owner = cli / issues-tooling lane (filed 01/10, labels `bug,jvm,1.0-outside`).
